description: Product software in the browser — dashboards, admin consoles, back-office and internal tools — where repeated use, scannable density, data states and keyboard fluency decide quality; marketing pages stay in page and redesign flows.

stages.purpose: Establish who operates the product, their recurring decisions and top tasks, the data model and volumes, roles and permissions, and the states the UI must survive.

gates.require: target screens, operator intent, preserve/forbidden constraints and source owner are explicit

operator roles, recurring decisions, top tasks with frequency, data entities with realistic volumes, permission differences and data freshness requirements are explicit; unknown volumes or roles are recorded as UNKNOWN

Before visual direction, the UX Readiness verdict from ux-structure-and-flow-design is READY or READY_WITH_RISKS: every top task has a user flow with a happy path and a failure path ending in recovery; every key screen records user question, information priority, one primary action, destination, feedback and recovery; walkthrough findings have severity, fix and retest with no open blocker. When docs/ux/ux-structure.json exists, check-ux-structure.py must PASS. Expert walkthroughs are agent-heuristic evidence, never participant research.
material user/problem claims distinguish direct evidence from proxy/inference and define a truthful validation plan when direct evidence is unavailable
intended user and owner outcomes, baseline or UNKNOWN, measurement source and instrumentation owner are explicit

stages.purpose: Define shell, navigation, density, summary-before-detail hierarchy, data display and every data state using the existing design system unless the task changes it.

gates.require: app shell, navigation model, density mode, summary-before-detail order, table and chart choices, keyboard paths and empty/loading/error/no-permission/partial-data states are concrete before implementation
canonical decision checker verifies numeric roles, source traces and distinct composition topology; this is not aesthetic acceptance
consequential solution hypotheses have direct validation evidence or are explicitly labeled PLANNED/UNVALIDATED before irreversible implementation

stages.purpose: Implement reusable, accessible data UI: tables with sort/filter/selection, charts drawn to scale, URL-persisted filters and keyboard shortcuts, without regressing shared owners.

gates.require: page acceptance criteria are mapped to the affected route and shared component regression surface
critical outcome metrics have event/data-source definitions, privacy/consent considerations, owners and verification before release

stages.purpose: Inspect rendered screens with realistic and extreme data across widths and themes, every data state, keyboard-only operation and shared-owner regressions.

gates.require: target screens are inspected with realistic, empty, very large and error data at representative widths; numbers align and are locale-formatted; affected shared components show no material regression
decision contract references inspected desktop/mobile alternatives with actual capture digests and critique; preference remains unvalidated
Current rendered controls have verified focus indicators; source CSS lint is insufficient.
verified versus unverified areas are explicit; no production/accessibility/UX improvement claim exceeds evidence
an authorized human decision owner reviews unresolved risk, user evidence, outcome readiness and rollback/learning plan before production release when project policy requires it
post-launch signals, critical experiences, research/feedback sources, review cadence and experiment/rollout/rollback criteria are explicit

policies.reason: Page rendered QA failed; return to implementation with focused root-cause review.
Operator, data or permission assumptions were wrong; re-establish product truth before redesigning further.
Page work gained production risk; add system reality and verification specialists.
Diagnose repeated tool failure rather than blind retry.
Blocked page work needs decision reframing and constraint review.
